articles.summary: Six TOWER Token gambles.
findings: Energy: success maxes it; failure no change.
Non-Legendary affixes (plus Truth Fossils): one random 0-100% roll positions every prefix/suffix in its range, rounded; 100% = all max.
Priceless: success rerolls every base affix (count kept); failure deletes one.
Corroded Legendary: success rerolls corrosion bases; failure strips them and binds.
Undetermined Fate: success rerolls slot types/count; failure destroys it.
Fluorescent Memory: stake 1 to half (floor); result 0 to double.

assumptions: 'scaled by the percentage' read as position within each affix range, consistent with the page's 100% = max-roll example
